brand.name: Meridian
brand.tone: Confident and knowledgeable with genuine warmth — like a smart friend who explains things clearly without talking down to you.
brand.audience: Developers and technical teams building modern web applications

motion.philosophy: Subtle and purposeful. Animations should guide attention and confirm actions, never distract or delay. Every transition earns its place.

buttons.primaryStyle: Filled with primary color, subtle shadow, lifts slightly on hover with enhanced shadow
buttons.secondaryStyle: Outlined with primary border, transparent background, fills with primary-light on hover
buttons.tertiaryStyle: No border or background, primary text color, subtle background on hover

cards.hoverEffect: Lift with shadow-md transition, border becomes slightly more visible

inputs.focusRing: 2px ring in primary-light with 2px offset, border changes to primary
inputs.errorStyle: Border changes to error color, helper text appears below in error color with sm font size

navigation.style: Clean top nav with logo left, links center, CTA right. Subtle bottom border. Active link indicated with primary-colored underline.

dos: Always use CSS custom properties from the brand tokens, never hardcode values
Always import brand fonts from Google Fonts
Use the neutral scale for grays — never use generic gray hex values
Use semantic colors for status indicators (success/error/warning/info)
Maintain generous whitespace — when in doubt, add more space
Use the primary color sparingly for emphasis — it should draw the eye to important actions
Use the mono font for any code, technical identifiers, or numeric data
donts: Never use pure black (#000000) or pure white (#FFFFFF) — use neutral-950 and neutral-50
Never use more than 2 font weights on a single component
Never use border-radius values larger than lg (16px) except for pills (full)
Never use animation durations longer than 400ms
Never auto-play animations or use attention-seeking motion (bounce, shake, pulse)
Never use the accent color for large filled areas — it's for small highlights only
Never combine shadows with thick borders on the same element
